subject: Welcome to the team - please read before you start today
body:
Hi there,

Welcome to the team! We're excited to have you joining us today.

Please read this first-day note so you know where to begin:

1. Reply to this email so Alex Rivera knows you received it.
2. Watch for your calendar invite for the first-day check-in.
3. Bring any onboarding questions to that check-in - no question is too small.

If anything looks missing or you are blocked getting started, reply directly =
to this
message or contact Alex Rivera at manager-8ca92e87@partner.internal.example.

Welcome aboard,
Alex Rivera
